relations.quote: The procedure acts on fields of an array laid out as in [Address fields and array layout on tapes](address-fields.md).

The procedure is built from the [Address shear and lower-triangular factorization](address-shear-factorization.md): the network's endpoint operator is the shear $(H,D)\mapsto(H+D,D)$ over a residue ring, which is exactly $H\leftarrow H+D$, with its rank reduced by a lower-triangular factorization.
The network's cost bound follows from [Recursive power saving from s<Wm](recursive-power-saving.md), since the middle shear is computed by recursive calls on smaller streams of the array.
Exactness is secured by the [Restoring auxiliary scratch values](scratch-restoration.md) schedule, which subtracts the initial register value, computes, adds the result back, and reverses.

derivations.quote: Two further linear-cost address updates complete the interchange.
